Name: Android Limitless Zoom
Author: yuruichang
Description:
🌟 Description / 模组简介
[b][EN][/b] 
This mod removes the hardcoded pinch-to-zoom limits in the Android version of Stardew Valley (1.6+). By default, the Android client locks your zoom levels (preventing you from zooming out too far). This mod safely overrides those limits, allowing you to zoom out infinitely to see your entire farm layout at a glance, or zoom in extremely close for details. [b]Now includes full in-game configuration support via Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)![/b]

[b][ZH][/b] 
本模组解除了星露谷物语安卓端（1.6+）原生双指缩放的底层代码限制。原版游戏强制锁死了最大和最小的缩放比例，而本模组打破了这一限制，让你能够无限缩小视角，一眼纵览整个农场全貌，或者极限放大查看细节。[b]现已全面支持通过“通用模组配置菜单（GMCM）”在游戏内进行实时设置！[/b]
[line]
📦 Installation instructions / 安装说明
[b][EN][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI for Android[/b] (4.3.2 or later).[/*]
[*]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (1.14.1 or later).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the zip file.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]AndroidLimitlessZoom[/code]folder into your
[code]/sdcard/Android/data/abc.smapi.gameloader/files/Mods/[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and use two fingers to pinch and zoom! You can adjust the limits in the title screen or in-game mod settings menu.[/*]
[/list][b][ZH][/b]
[list=1]
[*]安装 [b]安卓版 SMAPI[/b] (需 4.3.2 或更高版本)。[/*]
[*]安装 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (通用模组配置菜单)[/b] (需 1.14.1 或更高版本)。[/*]
[*]下载本模组并解压缩。[/*]
[*]将解压出的
[code]AndroidLimitlessZoom[/code]文件夹放入手机的
[code] /sdcard/Android/data/abc.smapi.gameloader/files/Mods/ [/code]目录中。[/*]
[*]启动游戏，直接在屏幕上使用双指捏合即可自由缩放！你可以在主界面或游戏内的模组设置菜单中自定义缩放极限。[/*]
[/list][line]
✨ Main features / 主要特性
[b][EN][/b]
[list]
[*][b]True Limitless Zoom:[/b] Bypasses the native zoom cap.[/*]
[*][b]In-Game Configuration:[/b] Fully integrated with GMCM. You can dynamically adjust your preferred Minimum Zoom (default 0.05) and Maximum Zoom (default 15.0) limits directly in the game settings without restarting![/*]
[*][b]Native Gesture Support:[/b] Uses the game's built-in pinch-to-zoom mechanics. No virtual buttons or hotkeys required.[/*]
[*][b]Smooth & Jitter-Free:[/b] Achieved via Harmony IL transpilers targeting the Android-specific PinchZoom class, ensuring the camera scales smoothly without screen jittering.[/*]
[*][b]Android Exclusive:[/b] Specifically built for the Android 1.6+ mobile environment.[/*]
[/list][b][ZH][/b]
[list]
[*][b]真正的无限缩放：[/b] 打破原生视距限制。[/*]
[*][b]游戏内实时配置：[/b] 完美集成 GMCM。无需重启游戏，你可以直接在游戏设置中动态调整你想要的“最小缩放限制”（默认 0.05）和“最大缩放限制”（默认 15.0）！[/*]
[*][b]原生手势支持：[/b] 完美兼容游戏自带的双指捏合手势，不需要设置任何虚拟按键或快捷键。[/*]
[*][b]丝滑无抖动：[/b] 通过 Harmony Transpiler 技术直接替换底层指令，彻底告别其他视角模组在手机端常见的画面闪烁和抖动问题。[/*]
[*][b]安卓专供：[/b] 专为安卓端 1.6+ 的触控引擎重写和定制。[/*]
[/list][line]
⚠️ Requirements / 前置要求
[b][EN][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley for Android[/b] (1.6.15 or newer)[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI for Android[/b] (Version 4.3.2+)[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (Version 1.14.1+)[/*]
[/list][b][ZH][/b]
[list]
[*][b]星露谷物语安卓版[/b] (1.6.15 或更新版本)[/*]
[*][b]安卓版 SMAPI[/b] (必须是 4.3.2 或以上版本)[/*]
[*][b]通用模组配置菜单 (GMCM)[/b] (必须是 1.14.1 或以上版本)[/*]
[/list][line]
